en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a harbor scene with several sailing boats and small craft in the foreground and a coastal city in the background. Buildings line the waterfront, and farther out a fort-like structure sits on a small promontory. Printed captions in Spanish at the bottom identify the view as from La Coruña and note the publisher's address. There is a handwritten note reading "Souvenir" with a signature and a date, plus part of a green Spanish postage stamp in the lower right corner.
